courses.title: NV Armed Security Officer Certification
courses.description: This two-day NASOC program exceeds Nevada's required course content and qualification standards for security firearms training. PFC's brand and reputation depend on graduating students who are among the most capable armed security officers in the state.

courses.title: Handgun Optics Skills Tactics
courses.description: Handgun Optics Skills & Tactics (HOST) develops miniaturized red dot sight skills for the defensive handgun practitioner, allowing them to deploy this revolutionary technology with competence and confidence. Students leave with the ability to effectively run optics-equipped handguns in defensive and protective scenarios.

courses.title: Protective Security Operations Certification
courses.description: Protective Security Operations Certification (PSOC) is designed exclusively for private security, Federal Government, DoD, and law enforcement professionals interested in learning modern methods for executive protection and personal security of high-value clients. This comprehensive certification covers advance work, threat assessment, principal movement, and protective team operations.

courses.title: Protective Pistol Skills
courses.description: Protective Pistol Skills (PPS) is PFC's 2-day weapons-centric certification that is entirely range-based, covering combative concealed handgun skills and tactics as they apply to third-person principal defense, principal cover, and protective movement.

courses.title: Protective Driving Operations Certification (PDOC)
courses.description: Proper usage of motor vehicles is a critical factor in executive driving and protective security operations, where safe and proper conduct can mean the difference between a satisfied client and a deadly incident. PDOC provides comprehensive training in protective driving techniques, route planning, and vehicle-based threat response.

courses.title: Progressive Protection Training
courses.description: No protective agent or team maximizes their potential without a strong foundation — PPT1 sets up your skills for success through a structured introduction to executive protection principles, protocols, and practical application. Students leave with the core competencies needed to operate effectively on a protective detail.

courses.title: Progressive Protection Training 2
courses.description: Success lies in preparation, and PPT2 focuses on the tactics, techniques, and procedures of sound advance work for protective operations. Students develop reliable, structured skills for anticipating threats, securing environments, and managing the complexities of professional executive protection.

courses.title: Covert Operations Protective Surveillance
courses.description: Modern protective operations often require judgment, discretion, and unique skills — particularly the ability to perform surveillance in support of the principal's safety. COPS trains security personnel in covert protective surveillance and low-visibility operations essential for modern protective work.

courses.title: Residential Security Operations Certification (RSOC)
courses.description: Residential Security Operations Certification (RSOC) is a full-scale 4-day training and qualification course for personnel active on estate security details or individuals interested in entry-level protective detail positions. Students gain tactical skills, site assessment techniques, and crisis response protocols for high-value residential environments.

Course Details With the advent of miniature red dot sights for handguns, training, and operational deployment is undergoing a radical and rapid evolution. Unfortunately, the MRDS is far less intuitive than its bigger brother on the carbine. A sound and solid foundation within an agency/organization is a must for the logical, progressive, and safe rollout of these innovative systems. Handgun Optic Instructor Skills and Tactics Certification or HOIST-C aims to equip law-enforcement handgun firearms instructors with the knowledge, tools, tactics, techniques, and procedures to competently and confidently bring your agency into this modern, albeit more biologically conducive, domain. Adopting this technology cannot end simply with the purchase and the “owner’s manual.” In short, HOIST-C sets your fellow officers up to win. Topics covered include: Pragmatic safety and the risk analysis tool Advanced instructor development The 5-point information delivery model Optic selection (pros, cons & options) Support equipment & maintenance Five varieties of dot acquisition Shooter-related problems & associated remediation Optic-related problems/malfunction Weapon re-function-related problems Low light operations Student led-teach backs Written examination and live fire skills test   Enrollment: Open to the Department of Defense, law enforcement, government agencies, and eligible government contractors. Pre Requisites: Prior handgun training experience   IMPORTANT NOTES:  TRAVELING – If you are traveling from out of town, please contact Training Coordinator, Amanda Dunn at Amanda@pfcgoc.com or call 702-647-1126, to confirm enrollment requirements for the course have been met BEFORE booking any travel.  WEAPON RENTALS – If you require weapon rentals from PFC, please be sure to add the rental to your ticket at the time of purchase, and immediately notify Training Coordinator, Amanda Dunn at Amanda@pfcgoc.com or call 702-647-1126, to confirm rental availability and pickup details.  AMMO – If you require ammo from PFC Loadout, please purchase at pfcloadout.com, adding course name and date in the notes, and notify Training Coordinator, Amanda Dunn at Amanda@pfcgoc.com or call 702-647-1126, to confirm availability and pickup details.  DEADLINE – Rentals and ammo MUST be purchased NLT 2 days prior to the course beginning.  QUESTIONS – If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to Training Coordinator, Amanda Dunn at Amanda@pfcgoc.com or call 702-647-1126.

courses.title: EMERGENCY RESPONSE TEAM–INITIAL TRAINING
courses.description: This five-day ERT-IT certification program includes three days of handgun skills training, two days focused on security saturation and crisis response tactics, and comprehensive scenario-based training for emergency response team members. Students develop the coordinated skills needed for effective team-based threat response.

courses.title: Modern Structure Clearing Strategies
courses.description: This two-day MSCS training course exposes students to Progressive FORCE Concepts' innovative methods for safely clearing structures while mitigating risk. Topics covered include PFC's core principles of dynamic entry, room clearing, and structure-based threat neutralization.

courses.title: Modern Use of Force Legal Responsibility (MUFLR)
courses.description: This eight-hour MUFLR course is designed for security professionals active in field operations, addressing use-of-force topics to prepare students before an incident occurs. Training covers force continuum, legal liability, and real-world decision-making for security professionals.

courses.title: NV Armed Security Officer Certification
courses.description: This two-day NASOC program exceeds Nevada's required course content and qualification standards for security firearms training. PFC's brand and reputation depend on graduating students who are among the most capable armed security officers in the state.

courses.title: Protective Emergency Casualty Care (PECC)
courses.description: Executive protection and personal security professionals must be prepared to respond decisively when medical emergencies occur — whether managing traumatic injury, sudden cardiac arrest, severe allergic reactions, or opioid overdose. PECC delivers the critical medical skills protection professionals need to keep principals and teammates alive.

courses.title: Protective Services Operations Certification (PSOC)
courses.description: Protective Security Operations Certification (PSOC) is designed exclusively for private security, Federal Government, DoD, and law enforcement professionals interested in learning modern methods for executive protection and personal security of high net-worth or at-risk individuals. This five-day certification is approved by multiple federal, state, and corporate organizations and is the only major university-accredited protective services training program in the United States. PSOC teaches contemporary low-visibility personal security skills for permissive to semi-permissive environments and creates a comprehensive, balanced foundation for prospective and current members of protective details.

courses.title: Full Spectrum Operator Course (FSOC) OPEN
courses.description: FSOC is an intensive 5-day training experience for tactical personnel tasked with operating in high-risk environments. Widely known as PFC's flagship tactical course, FSOC covers full-spectrum operator skills from small unit tactics to advanced firearms employment and scenario-based threat response.

courses.title: Protective Driving Operations Certification (PDOC)
courses.description: Protective Driving Operations Certification (PDOC) provides comprehensive training in the critical motor vehicle skills required for executive driving and protective security operations. Students learn evasive driving techniques, route planning, and vehicle-based threat response protocols.

courses.title: Protective Operations Supervisor Training
courses.description: Protective Operations Supervisor Training (POST) is an intensive 1-day course designed for security managers, team leaders, and anyone responsible for personnel in protective services. This fully-loaded professional supervisor's course covers leadership responsibilities, liability awareness, and team operational management.

courses.title: Covert Operations Protective Surveillance
courses.description: Modern protective operations require security professionals who can perform surveillance with judgment, discretion, and operational skill. COPS is a four-day course covering surveillance theory and practice, fixed and mobile operations (foot and vehicular), counter-surveillance measures, surveillance detection, and pre-attack surveillance case studies. Students develop the ability to blend into any environment, collect and disseminate intelligence as part of a team, and identify exploitable patterns.
